name: SVC_STD_TXT_HISTORY
description: This table stores the history table of Standard Text usage for user reporting.

columns.name: STD_TXT_HIST_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID. Indicates the user that used the Standard Text.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Foreign Key to the Type of the Standard Text used.

columns.name: OBJECT_USED
columns.description: The object this Standard Text was used in.

columns.name: OBJECT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Unique reference to the row in the object this Standard Text was used in.

columns.name: OBJECT_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the primary key of the referenced object

columns.name: STD_TXT_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the Standard Text.

columns.name: STDTXT_NAME
columns.description: Short descriptive name for the Standard Text.

columns.name: TEXT
columns.description: The actual Standard Text that was used after variable substitution.

columns.name: TXT_LANG
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.
